title: Crispy Bitter Crumble Dessert
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert inspired by Chinese flavors, featuring a crumbly topping and creamy yogurt.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together the chocolate, oatmeal, and brown sugar.
3. Add the yogurt and mix until a dough forms.
4. Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch (6 mm).
5. Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
6. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the dough.
8. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
9. Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
